examples.title: Add room reflections and save audio
examples.summary: Load the OA narration, convert it to mono, normalize it, render a native GPU reverberation tail, then save a checked WAV output.

presentation.title: Before / after
presentation.description: Play the authored narration beside the artifact produced by this exact SDK example. The processed WAV is copied byte-for-byte from var/example/audio/oaNarrationRoom.wav after a successful run.

items.label: Source
items.description: The unprocessed OA narration loaded by the example.

items.label: Processed
items.description: Normalized, faded, and rendered through oa::FnAudio::reverb with a 1.5 second tail.

presentation.title: oa::Viewer
presentation.description: The processed WAV opened by this example's optional --preview path in OA's native GPU waveform viewer.
presentation.alt: oa::Viewer displaying the processed OA narration as a GPU-rendered waveform

examples.title: Convert and save a grayscale image
examples.summary: Load the Vision cover, convert its GPU-resident RGB pixels to Rec.709 grayscale, save the semantic Gray image, and optionally inspect it in Viewer.

items.label: Grayscale output

examples.title: Hash a message batch with SHAKE-256
examples.summary: Run three SHAKE-256 digests on the GPU and compare every output byte with the independent CPU implementation.

presentation.title: Verified Python run
presentation.description: Runtime evidence from the generated Python example on an Intel Iris Xe Vulkan device. One SHAKE-256 shader pipeline handles the complete three-message batch.
